name: biz-site-builder
description: Scrape/ingest local business listings, detect which ones lack a website, and auto-build a static site + a hyperframes promo video for each from its profile, images and community reviews.

scripts.demo: bun run src/cli.ts build --source csv:fixtures/businesses.sample.csv --source json:fixtures/businesses.sample.json --out .out --target both --video
scripts.demo:registry: bun run src/cli.ts build --source registry:file=fixtures/registry.sample.json --market israel --out .out-registry --target both --quotes
